articles.title: RedotPay completes financial audit as it presses ahead with U.S. IPO plans
articles.snippet: The stablecoin payments company said the audit is part of its preparations to go public, disputing an August report that the listing had been put on hold.

articles.title: Binance deal gives Circle a boost in stablecoin race with Tether, analysts say
articles.snippet: The five-year deal could strengthen USDC’s reach in emerging markets, though Tether’s liquidity advantage remains hard to dislodge, analysts told CoinDesk.

articles.title: Bybit accepts Franklin Templeton tokenized funds as trading collateral
articles.snippet: Eligible institutions can pledge Benji-issued fund shares for stablecoin credit lines while keeping the underlying assets in off-exchange custody.

articles.title: Citi Clients Can Now Take Stablecoin Payments Through Coinbase—Without Touching Crypto
articles.snippet: Coinbase and Citi expanded an existing deal so Citi's institutional clients can accept stablecoin payments, while Coinbase business accounts run on Citi's banking rails.

articles.title: Circle and Tether Freeze Stablecoins Tied to Bitget Hack—But Most Funds Slip Away
articles.snippet: The two stablecoin issuers blacklisted a wallet labeled "Bitget Exploiter 8," locking about $318,000 in USDC and USDT—but the attacker swapped most funds into unfreezable ETH before they could act.
